title: Next.js Frontend Developer (Fresher / Entry-Level)
description:
**Company:** Plus UAE Group  
**Subsidiary:** Vortexen Dynamics Industrial Solutions  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** Starting from ₹18,000 per month  
**Experience:** Freshers can apply

Job Description

Vortexen Dynamics Industrial Solutions, a subsidiary of Plus UAE Group, is looking for a motivated and technically curious Next.js Frontend Developer to join our development team in Kochi.

We welcome fresh graduates and entry-level candidates who have a strong foundation in web development and are eager to build modern, responsive, and high-performance web applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with the development team to implement user interfaces, integrate APIs, develop reusable components, and contribute to real-world web application projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using React.js and Next.js.
* Build reusable UI components using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Implement website layouts that work smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Work with Next.js routing, layouts, and Server and Client Components.
* Integrate REST APIs and display dynamic data in frontend applications.
* Use Tailwind CSS or other modern styling techniques to build consistent interfaces.
* Identify and resolve UI bugs, rendering issues, and frontend performance problems.
* Collaborate with backend developers and UI/UX designers to deliver functional features.
* Maintain clean, readable, and reusable code.
* Learn and apply industry-standard development practices under the guidance of senior team members.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and web development fundamentals.
* Understanding of React.js, including components, props, state, and hooks.
* Basic knowledge of Next.js or a strong willingness to learn it.
* Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
* Understanding of API integration and JSON data.
* Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
* Strong logical thinking, debugging ability, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of TypeScript.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS.
* Familiarity with Next.js App Router.
* Experience building personal projects, academic projects, or portfolio websites.
* Familiarity with GitHub and frontend deployment platforms.

Eligibility

* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with relevant personal projects or internship experience will be preferred.
* Applicants should have a genuine interest in frontend development and modern web technologies.
* Candidates must be willing to work from our Kochi office.

What We Offer

* Starting salary of ₹18,000 per month.
* Opportunity to work on real-world software development projects.
* Practical exposure to modern frontend technologies and development workflows.
* Guidance and opportunities to develop technical skills.
* A collaborative working environment with scope for professional growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with links to their GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant projects, if available.

**Work Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Work from Office

We encourage candidates who are passionate about building modern web applications to apply, including those beginning their professional careers.

Pay: From ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
